title: Supporting Rapid Growth with Managed IT Services
summary: Learn how CBIZ provided managed IT services to help a financial institution grow from $60 million to over $1 billion in assets.
body_markdown:
## Issue


A growing financial institution experienced significant expansion, increasing from approximately $60 million in assets to more than $1 billion over two-to-three years. As the bank entered new markets, opened additional locations, and added employees, its technology environment and IT compliance program needed to evolve at the same pace.


The growth introduced broader regulatory expectations and more complex IT compliance responsibilities. The bank needed support for policies, procedures, technology risk assessments, and compliance tools. At the same time, it needed to maintain reliable technology across a growing number of offices and employees.


Addressing these needs entirely through internal hiring would have required the organization to add multiple specialized resources. The bank needed an approach that could supplement its existing IT capabilities while allowing the organization to continue growing without placing unnecessary pressure on its internal team.


## Solution


CBIZ provided managed IT services and strategic advisory support designed to scale with the bank’s changing needs. The team helped implement expandable software, hardware, and technology configurations that could accommodate additional employees and locations.


The engagement also helped the bank mature its IT compliance program. Policies, procedures, risk management activities, and supporting tools evolved from those appropriate for a small community bank into a more structured program capable of supporting a larger and faster-growing financial institution.


Rather than replacing the bank’s internal resources, CBIZ supplemented its existing capabilities with specialized technology and compliance experience. This model provided the organization with access to broader expertise without requiring it to build every competency internally.


## Outcome


With scalable technology and ongoing managed services support in place, the bank continued expanding into multiple locations and states while maintaining technological stability. Its IT compliance support strengthened as the organization grew, helping reduce operational and compliance risk.


The bank also reduced the need to hire multiple specialized internal resources as its technology and compliance responsibilities expanded. CBIZ supplemented the bank’s internal IT capabilities, helping the organization continue operating and scaling as its technology and compliance requirements evolved. Throughout that expansion, the bank maintained the technology and compliance support needed to serve a larger, more complex operation.
